body.name: \mathfrak{H}_{G}
body.construction: Starting from the localized KBRW \(R\)-normal equations at \(x_0\) and tuning \((h_n^*,k_n^*)\), form the local empirical basis Gram matrix from the same weighted observations that enter the higher-order kernels. Replace the density-based projection by its empirically centered inverse-Gram expansion, apply partition-lattice M\"obius inversion to cancel repeated-index collisions, select the finite truncation order from the localized remainder bound, screen the spectrum, and clip both the score ratio and every exceptional-event fallback to \([-2L,2L]\). The handle forbids a density estimate and uses the \(G_n=1\) inequality as the effective-sample rank condition; the exact kernel algebra is to be derived in \(\mathrm{thm:rank\mbox{-}feasible\mbox{-}local\mbox{-}hoif}\).
